name: Hearth pork belly
summary: Pork belly smoked on the hearth in mắc khén, garlic, ginger, and chili, on the same smoke used for the buffalo.
origin: Báo Sơn La, 1 April 2022 and 15 May 2025.
howToEat: As the smoked belly, or carry it.
where: Phường Chiềng Cơi, on the 15 May 2025 account.
seoTitle: Ba chi gac bep in Son La — hearth pork belly
seoDescription: Ba chỉ gác bếp, also called ba chỉ hun khói, in Sơn La. Báo Sơn La puts it on the Chiềng Cơi hearth smoke.
